name: week
description: Monday that starts the ISO week the row covers.

name: region
description: Harbor & Pine US sales region (8 regions).

name: week_index
description: Weeks since 2024-01-01, 0 to 103; the linear trend term.

name: revenue_k
description: Online revenue for the region-week in thousands of USD; the MMM target.

name: tv_spend_k
description: Linear TV media spend allocated to the region-week, thousands of USD.

name: search_spend_k
description: Paid search spend for the region-week, thousands of USD.

name: social_spend_k
description: Paid social spend for the region-week, thousands of USD.

name: display_spend_k
description: Programmatic display spend for the region-week, thousands of USD.

name: email_ksends
description: Marketing emails delivered in the region-week, thousands of sends.

name: discount_pct
description: Average sitewide discount depth for the week, percent off list.

name: promo
description: True when a named sitewide promotion ran that week.

name: holiday
description: True for weeks containing a US retail holiday.

name: competitor_sov
description: Competitor share of voice in the category, 0 to 1, from an ad-intelligence vendor.

name: category_demand
description: Category search-demand index for the region, 100 = Jan 2024 national level.
